Equipped with a heavy-duty sliding system (such as double wheels, multiple wheels, or industrial-grade pulleys with strong load-bearing) and a sturdy lower track (track width is usually wider, such as 40mm, 50mm or even wider). It can bearing the huge weight of door panels and ensure long term smooth pushing and pulling.
body: Heavy duty sliding door is a high-performance door system that combines multiple advantages. It is mainly used in places that require a larger opening space and have high requirements for thermal insulation, sound insulation, safety and durability.

title: Automatic Balcony Patio Thermal Insulation Aluminum Heavy Duty Sliding Door
intro: Safe and reliable: Strong wind resistance; excellent anti-theft. Practical and convenient: Large opening size enhances natural light and ventilation, facilitating the movement of large items; low track design enables smooth-free access. Beautiful and customizable: Modern minimalist design complements various decoraction styles, with options for color, glass patterns, and other personalized customizations.
body: Strong Structure: wide cross-section, elegant and transparent appearance. Outstanding Performance: Sealing rubber strips and precision track design ensure excellent airtightness, watertightness, and sound insulation; high-quality hardware ensure smooth and durable sliding operation.
Aluminium Heavy-duty sliding doors is a type of door and window with superior performance and wide application.

title: Wind Resistant Double Glazed Silent Aluminium Exterior Heavy Duty Sliding Door
intro: Heavy duty sliding door is a kind of sliding door with large thickness frame. Frame made of large wall thickness aluminium profile. Matching with high load bearing wheels, panels can slide smoothly and be stable on the tracks. Panels won ’ t shake when suffer from windy weather. High level lower rail can prevent rainwater floating to interior. Double glass filled with argon gas. Can insulate sound from outsides. Supply a silent environment. Thermal insulation system can stabilize interior temperature. Makes interior environment be steady.
body: Wind resistant is one of the most important feature of heavy duty sliding door. Because of the multi-cavity structure and large thickness profiles, improve the bending resistant and overall stability of the profile. Can effectively resist deformation caused by wind pressure. So heavy duty sliding door can resist strong wind even hurricane and typhoon.
